worked.problem: Kite ABCD has perpendicular diagonals AC=6 cm and BD=6 cm. Find its area.
actions: Draw kite ABCD and its diagonals AC and BD.

Use area=½×AC×BD=½×6×6.
Calculate 18 cm².
Answer: area = 18 cm². Both diagonal lengths were used once.

worked.problem: In parallelogram ABCD, opposite side AB=7 cm and diagonals meet at O with AO=6 cm. Find DC and OC.

Mark intersection O and AO=6 cm.
The diagonals bisect each other: OC=AO.
Answer: DC = 7 cm; OC = 6 cm. Do not claim that the two whole diagonals are equal.
